scripts.predev: prisma migrate deploy --schema src/prisma/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema src/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.build:staging: APP_ENV=staging NODE_ENV=production DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.staging npm run build
scripts.build:production: APP_ENV=production NODE_ENV=production DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.production npm run build
scripts.db:sync: prisma migrate deploy --schema src/prisma/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema src/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.env:check:staging: APP_ENV=staging NODE_ENV=production DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.staging ts-node src/scripts/envAudit.ts check
scripts.env:check:production: APP_ENV=production NODE_ENV=production DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.production ts-node src/scripts/envAudit.ts check
scripts.env:info:staging: APP_ENV=staging NODE_ENV=production DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.staging ts-node src/scripts/envAudit.ts info
scripts.env:info:production: APP_ENV=production NODE_ENV=production DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.production ts-node src/scripts/envAudit.ts info
scripts.db:generate:staging: APP_ENV=staging NODE_ENV=production DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.staging node ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js generate --schema src/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate:deploy:staging: APP_ENV=staging NODE_ENV=production DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.staging node ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js migrate deploy --schema src/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:generate:production: APP_ENV=production NODE_ENV=production DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.production node ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js generate --schema src/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate:deploy:production: APP_ENV=production NODE_ENV=production DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.production node ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js migrate deploy --schema src/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:push-force: node src/prisma/drop-index.js && prisma db push --schema src/prisma/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss
